WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(brokrepstat, '<missing>') AS status,
    AVG(modelconf) AS avg_modelconf
  FROM compliancecase
  GROUP BY COALESCE(brokrepstat, '<missing>')
), qualifying AS (
  SELECT status, avg_modelconf
  FROM status_averages
  WHERE avg_modelconf > (SELECT AVG(modelconf) FROM compliancecase)
), reference AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) AS qualifying_mean
  FROM qualifying
)
SELECT
  q.status,
  q.avg_modelconf,
  q.avg_modelconf - (SELECT AVG(modelconf) FROM compliancecase) AS above_average,
  q.avg_modelconf / r.qualifying_mean AS ratio_to_qualifying_mean
FROM qualifying q
CROSS JOIN reference r
WHERE r.qualifying_mean IS NOT NULL;
